svg.title: Parlour: Felt appliqué
svg.desc: Parlour (1D): the guests' counting game seen from above, all cut felt and buttons. Thirty felt spaces spiral from the Door to the Hearth; the pegs are buttons. A small stuffed paw drags one guest's button onto the Lamp, the symbol that is that guest's own, while footprints at the doorway grow larger as someone comes back. Two of three tamper buttons are still unspent.
